requirements.requirement: NGFW (FW + IPS + AVC) throughput must be 10 GBPS for Mix / production traffic or higher from Day 1  Throughput should be 65 Gbps or higher from the day of deployment  The proposed solution should have minimum 10 Gbps of Threat Prevention (FW + IPS + AVC + AV) throughput for Mix / production traffic or higher from Day 1  The proposed solution should have 2000 or more site-to-site & client to site VPN Tunnels.
requirements.source_text:
NGFW (FW + IPS + 
AVC) throughput must be 10 GBPS for Mix / production traffic or 
higher from Day 1 
 Throughput should be 65 Gbps or higher from the day of 
deployment 
 The proposed solution should have minimum 10 Gbps of Threat 
Prevention (FW + IPS + AVC + AV) throughput for Mix / production 
traffic or higher from Day 1 
 The proposed solution should have 2000 or more site-to-site & 
client to site VPN Tunnels.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution shall support Multi-zone VPN, IPSec, ESP security, NAT traversal, Hub and Spoke architecture, and Redundant gateway architecture.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall support the following IPSEC VPN capabilities: o Multi-zone VPN supports. o IPSec, ESP security. o Supports NAT traversal o Supports Hub and Spoke architecture o Supports Redundant gateway architecture

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution shall support 2 forms of site-to-site VPN configurations: Route based IPSec tunnel and Policy based IPSec tunnel.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall support 2 forms of site-to-site VPN configurations: o  Route based IPSec tunnel o  Policy based IPSec tunnel

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution shall support IPSEC site-to-site VPN and remote user VPN in transparent mode.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall support IPSEC site-to-site VPN and remote user VPN in transparent mode.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution shall provide IPv6 IPSec feature to support secure IPv6 traffic in an IPSec VPN.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall provide IPv6 IPSec feature to support for secure IPv6 traffic in an IPSec VPN.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution appliance must have at least 10 virtual firewall domains/instances active from deployment, scalable to 200 with additional license.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution appliance must have at least 10 virtual firewall domains /instants active from the day of deployment scalable to 200 (with additional license) with each firewall domains/instances having a separate administrative control OR equivalent, Security zones and VLAN.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution appliance must support scalability to 200 virtual firewall domains/instances with additional license.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution appliance must have at least 10 virtual firewall domains /instants active from the day of deployment scalable to 200 (with additional license) with each firewall domains/instances having a separate administrative control OR equivalent, Security zones and VLAN.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should have integrated Antivirus solution.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have integrated Antivirus solution

requirements.requirement: The proposed system should block, allow, or monitor using AV signatures and file blocking based on per firewall policy or authenticated user groups for HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, POP3, POP3S, IMAP, IMAPS, FTP, FTPS.
requirements.source_text: The proposed system should be able to block, allow or monitor only using AV signatures and file blocking based on per firewall policy based or based on firewall authenticated user groups with configurable selection of the following services: o HTTP, HTTPS o SMTP, SMTPS o POP3, POP3S o IMAP, IMAPS o FTP, FTPS

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should detect and prevent advanced Malware, Zero-day attacks, spear phishing, drive-by downloads, watering hole attacks, and targeted Advanced Persistent Threats without relying solely on signature databases.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should be able to detect and prevent advanced Malware, Zero-day attack, spear phishing attack, drive by download, watering hole and targeted Advanced Persistent Threat without relying on just Signature database.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should perform dynamic real-time analysis of advanced malware on the appliance and utilize cloud infrastructure for analysis and detection.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should be able to perform dynamic real-time analysis of advanced malware on the appliance itself to confirm true zero- day and targeted attacks. Cloud infrastructure system for analysis and detection of Malware.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should block or allow oversized files based on configurable thresholds per protocol type and firewall policy.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should be able to block or allow oversize file based on configurable thresholds for each protocol types and per firewall policy.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should have integrated Web Content Filtering without external solutions, devices, or hardware modules.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have integrated Web Content Filtering solution without external solution, devices or hardware modules.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should enable or disable Web Filtering per firewall policy or authenticated user groups for HTTP and HTTPS traffic.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should be able to enable or disable Web Filtering per firewall policy or based on firewall authenticated user groups for both HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

requirements.source_text: The proposed solution must support at least 10 Virtual Domains from day 1

requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall be able to operate on either Transparent (bridge) mode to minimize interruption to existing network infrastructure or NAT/Route mode. Both modes can also be available concurrently using Virtual Contexts

requirements.requirement: Solution must support IPSEC, PPTP, and L2TP VPN
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should support o IPSEC VPN o PPTP VPN o L2TP VPN

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution shall query a real-time database of over 110 million rated websites categorized into 70+ unique content categories.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution shall be able to queries a real time database of over 110 million + rated websites categorized into 70+ unique content categories.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should support Active/Standby and Active/Active failover without stacking units in clustering.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should support Active/Standby and Active/Active failover and should not be based on stacking units in clustering.

requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should support ether channel or equivalent functionality for the failover control and providing additional level of redundancy.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should support redundant interfaces for interface-level redundancy before device failover.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should support redundant interfaces to provide interface level redundancy before device failover.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should support 802.3ad EtherChannel or equivalent functionality to increase bandwidth for a segment.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should support 802.3ad  Ether channel or equivalent functionality  to increase the bandwidth for a segment.

requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have integrated redundant power supply.

requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have 240 GB of  Hard Drive Capacity for logging and reporting.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should provide real-time display of network usage trends (e.g., source IP, destination URL for HTTP traffic).
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have real-time display of information allows to follow real-time trends in network usage such as the source IP address and the destination URL for HTTP traffic.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should allow configuration, management, and monitoring of NGFW via CLI and GUI without centralized management.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have ability to configure, manage and monitor NGFW  using CLI and GUI both without central management solution.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution should include inbuilt two-factor authentication for at least two admin users.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution should have inbuilt feature for two factor authentication for at least two admin users access.

requirements.requirement: The proposed solution must include IPS Detection, IPS Mitigation, and External Centralized Management/Monitoring System.
requirements.source_text: The proposed solution must comprise of IPS Detection, IPS Mitigation (Detection and Mitigation can be proposed on the same hardware appliance) and External Centralized Management and monitoring system.
